name: Neo Geo CD
significance: Made the arcade-masterpiece library of SNK accessible to consumers, despite being hampered by single-speed CD-ROM loading times.

editorialContent.overview: SNK's optical disc alternative to the prohibitively expensive AES cartridge system, slashing game prices to $50.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Made the arcade-masterpiece library of SNK accessible to consumers, despite being hampered by single-speed CD-ROM loading times.
editorialContent.controllerDesign: Neo Geo CD control pad (thumb-switch microswitches)
